summary: Trinity Biotech filed a Form 6-K on August 28, 2026, providing a routine business and corporate update. The press release details commercial progress, including the appointment of Jordi Romero as Head of Commercial Operations Europe, rollout of an upgraded HbA1c column system, and manufacturing outsourcing for HIV tests. It also notes progress on PrePsia patent portfolio expansion and an update on its Nasdaq listing. No special-situation transaction, strategic review, or major capital event is described. The filing is an ordinary operational update, not a special situation, so no deal terms apply.
